THE LAST ELECTION SPEECH BY OLOF PALME, PRIME MINISTER OF SWEDEN FROM 1969–1976 AND 1982–1986.

TP–7 field recorder.
there are thoughts, ideas and fragments that – for the sake of humanity –
we need to record and be able to return to as a reference, as a seed for new thoughts or
just to remember another time. TP–7 is built for just that; to record, edit, trim and layer whatever sound, with zero friction in the highest possible quality. it's not just a tape recorder; it's a dedicated piece of hardware that'll bring your next brilliant stroke to reality.

visit store
the ultimate sketchbook.

more than just a tape recorder—inside lies an advanced recording
and editing system for all audio purposes, packed with impressive features. the workflow has been carefully optimized, whether working with multi-track recordings or just a quick memo. turn on metronome and count-in, set cue points for your arrangements, re-do takes, loop and scratch, bounce, or just play back your favourite high-res record collection.

speak globally, transcribe locally.

whether you're a dentist capturing patient notes, a podcaster recording interviews, or an artist documenting your creative process, the TP–7 makes transcription in most languages effortless. open the TP–7 app on your preferred device, choose your language and hit transcribe.
it's your pocket-sized polyglot!

tape reel sensation.

the center piece of the TP–7 is the motorized tape reel. a delicately engineered brushless motor with extreme resolution that lets you virtually grab your recording. the reel is also used for scrubbing, scratching,
pausing, menu navigation and as gentle visual feedback
during playback and recording.

no more cold starts. one press on the memo
button automatically turns tp–7 on and
starts a new recording. 
capture thoughts with velocity.

inspiration rarely strikes at the perfect moment. picture yourself walking down the street when a fleeting idea hits. by the time you unlock your phone, locate the recording app, and hit record, the thought may already be gone. with the TP–7, you can easily outpace those moments.
just press the memo button on the right, even if the device is off.
ideas move fast, but the TP–7 moves faster.

the rocker.

TP–7 fits perfectly in the palm of your hand, with controls that feel intuitive and natural. the side-mounted rocker allows you to quickly scrub through your audio. just press on the top edge to fast forward, and down to rewind. watch the wheel spin around and hear your tracks scrub in ’hyperspeed’.

off the record.

picture yourself in an interview situation. the reel on the TP–7 is spinning
slowly, the bright red record lamp is lit. both the reel and the lamp indicates
that a recording is taking place. the interview is going quite well.
the situation gets heated, you're suddenly asked some personal questions.
in that moment, you gently place a finger on the reel and pause the
recording, allowing you to continue the interview ‘off the record’.
built in microphone, three two-way 3.5 mm stereo jacks that can be configured as inputs, outputs or HEADSET jacks.
listen to your recordings using the internal speaker or connect headphones or speakers to the 6.35 mm main out, or use the included 3.5mm adapter.
inputs, outputs and 20 years of ideas.

there are three stereo jacks on the TP–7 that can be set as either inputs
or outputs. this allows you to connect external mics and instruments,
like CM–15 and OP–1 field, recording with all channels simultaneously. or as outputs; headphones, studio monitors, or any other audio equipment.
use usb-c for multi-channel audio interface, midi, data transfer and charging, and bluetooth for wireless connectivity. add to that 128 GB of internal storage and you can preserve 5 minutes of ideas a day for 20 years.
interview
let you, and your subject, focus on the job at hand. when conducting interviews, TP–7's discreet size and dedicated function makes for an unobtrusive recording device. 
podcast
whether you're in the studio or out in the field, TP–7's high quality audio is perfect for podcast recording. connect up to 6 external mics, OR USE THE internal mic. set the levels and keep an eye on them with the vu meter.
dynamic editing
need to re-do a snippet of a take, multitrack or layer recordings, add cue markers, or loop? the TP–7 is your perfect companion for advanced recording and editing possibilities.
voice memos
think out loud, tP–7 does the rest. let TP–7 capture your thoughts, then convert them into accurate text in most languages using the tp–7 app. for professionals, and avid thinkers and writers.

TP–7
specifications
TP–7 highlights

  • 3x stereo two-way jack input/ output/headset connectors
  • 1x stereo headphones connector with 3.5 to 6.35 mm jack adapter
  • internal microphone and speaker
  • 128 GB internal storage
  • 24-bit/96 kHz usb audio interface
  • bluetooth low energy
  • rechargeable battery
  • 7 hr battery life
  • 64x32 pixel monochrome display

dimensions and weight

96 mm x 68 mm x 16 mm
170 g / 5.6 oz









electrical characteristics

two-way jacks (3.5 mm TRRS)
stereo input:
input impedance 9.5 kOhm
analog gain 0 - 42 dB
max level 8 dBu (2 Vrms)
SNR 105 dBA

headset: 
max level out 2 dBu (1 Vrms)
SNR 110 dBA
microphone SNR 98 dBA

headphone output (6.35 mm TRS)
max level 8 dBu (2 Vrms)
SNR 120 dBA
